description: In a nonempty directed preorder, a predicate holds eventually at the top filter if and only if it holds at every point above some threshold. Specializing to the naturals gives the eventual threshold criterion.
signature:
Filter.eventually_atTop.{u_3} {α : Type u_3} [Preorder α] [IsDirectedOrder α] {p : α → Prop} [Nonempty α] :
  (∀ᶠ (x : α) in Filter.atTop, p x) ↔ ∃ a, ∀ (b : α), a ≤ b → p b
